description: This file contains implementation of trust management functions for X509 certificates in OpenSSL, including trust table initialization, trust checking, and trust setting functions.

methods.name: X509_check_trust
methods.description: Checks the trust level of an X509 certificate based on trust ID and flags.

methods.name: X509_TRUST_get_count
methods.description: Returns the total number of trust entries, including standard and custom.

methods.name: X509_TRUST_get0
methods.description: Retrieves a trust entry by index.

methods.name: X509_TRUST_get_by_id
methods.description: Finds the index of a trust entry by trust ID.

methods.name: X509_TRUST_set
methods.description: Sets the trust value for a given trust object.

methods.name: X509_TRUST_add
methods.description: Adds a new trust entry with specified parameters.

methods.name: X509_TRUST_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and frees trust table resources.

methods.name: X509_TRUST_get_flags
methods.description: Returns the flags associated with a trust entry.

methods.name: X509_TRUST_get0_name
methods.description: Returns the name of a trust entry.

methods.name: X509_TRUST_get_trust
methods.description: Returns the trust level of a trust entry.
